title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 25
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 25: twenty-three years of warning, the seventy years of serving Babylon, and the cup of the wine of wrath for the nations.

questions.text: In which year of Jehoiakim's reign did this word come to Jeremiah?
questions.explanation: The word came concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, which was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.

questions.text: For how many years had Yahweh's word been coming to Jeremiah, from the thirteenth year of Josiah until that day?
questions.explanation: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, until that day, these twenty-three years, Yahweh's word had come to him and he had spoken to them, but they had not listened.

questions.text: What did the prophets' message tell the people not to do?
questions.explanation: The message was to return from their evil way and dwell in the land, and not to go after other gods to serve them or worship them, nor provoke Yahweh to anger with the work of their hands.

answers.text: Not to make bonds and bars for their necks
Not to build houses or plant gardens
Not to listen to the elders of the land
Not to go after other gods to serve and worship them

questions.text: Whom did Yahweh call "my servant" in the word about the families of the north?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said He would take all the families of the north and would send to Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and bring them against this land.

questions.text: Which of these did Yahweh say He would take away from them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said He would take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.

answers.text: The rain and the dew of the morning
Their flocks, their herds and their fields
The sound of the millstones and the light of the lamp
The words of all their own prophets

questions.text: For how long did Yahweh say these nations would serve the king of Babylon?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said the whole land would be a desolation and an astonishment, and that these nations would serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

questions.text: What did Yahweh say would happen when the seventy years were accomplished?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said He would punish the king of Babylon and that nation for their iniquity, and would make the land of the Chaldeans desolate forever.

answers.text: The nations would serve the king of Babylon seventy years more
Babylon would be given into the hand of the king of Egypt
The prophets of Babylon would all be silenced for ever
He would punish the king of Babylon and make the land of the Chaldeans desolate

questions.text: What was Jeremiah told to take from Yahweh's hand and make all the nations drink?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand, and cause all the nations to whom I send you to drink it."

answers.text: The cup of the wine of wrath
A book written against the nations

questions.text: Which king is said to drink after all the kingdoms of the world?
questions.explanation: After all the kings of the north and all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth, the text says, "The king of Sheshach will drink after them."

questions.text: According to verse 34, what will the shepherds fall like?
questions.explanation: The shepherds are told to wail and cry and wallow in dust, for the days of their slaughter have fully come, and they will fall like fine pottery.
